# HELP scylla_manager_scheduler_task_last_success_seconds End time of the last successful task run as a Unix timestamp. Unlike "last_success", which reports the start time of that run, this metric reports when the run actually finished, so that "time() - task_last_success_seconds" is the real age of the last success.
# TYPE scylla_manager_scheduler_task_last_success_seconds gauge
scylla_manager_scheduler_task_last_success_seconds{cluster="b703df56-c428-46a7-bfba-cfa6ee91b976",task="965f4f5c-c7d1-4ae6-b770-a2225df4ef49",type="backup"} 1.6455176e+09

# HELP scylla_manager_scheduler_task_state State of the last known task run: 0 - never run, 1 - running, 2 - done, 3 - error, 4 - stopped. The value is latched, so it describes the last run until the next one starts. The "type" label of tablet repair tasks is reported as "repair", so that filtering by type="repair" returns both vnode and tablet repair tasks.
# TYPE scylla_manager_scheduler_task_state gauge
